baseline_models.focus_anchor: The wave covers them like overhead canopies, whereupon they call God while making the dīn exclusive to Him.
baseline_models.mechanism: Layered external covering and intermingled turbulence strip away ordinary mixtures of allegiance; calling, purification, and exclusive obedience form a pressure-filtered devotion.

activation_trace.role: A cover literally rises over and hides them, supplying the enclosing pressure of the filter.
Intermingled turbulence destabilizes the prior arrangement and makes separation urgent.
An overhead canopy closes the scene vertically and intensifies exposure beneath it.
The spoken call inclines attention toward one addressee under pressure.
Purification after admixture makes emergency devotion an unmixing rather than merely an increase of feeling.
Obedience and submission name what the crisis temporarily concentrates on God alone.

changed_reading.before: They pray sincerely because they are afraid.
changed_reading.after: The storm acts as a pressure filter: enclosure and turbulence temporarily unmix a divided allegiance into exclusive obedience.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Mukhlisīn precedes divine rescue to the barr.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root of sincerity also images escape from entanglement; that inward extraction anticipates rescue by separation and arrival on flood-safe, dry ground. The body is extracted after allegiance has already enacted extraction.

activation_trace.role: Escape from a snare gives sincerity an active disentangling image.
Rescue by separation externalizes the prior inward disengagement.
Raised ground that flood cannot overtop supplies the topography of achieved extraction.
Dry land opposite sea is the concrete endpoint of the outward rescue.

changed_reading.before: Sincerity is an attitude followed by an unrelated physical rescue.
changed_reading.after: Sincerity and rescue repeat one mechanism at two levels: inward unentangling is followed by bodily separation onto flood-safe land.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: After the terrain changes from sea to barr, some are muqtasid.
baseline_models.mechanism: Qasd can be directed movement and a straight course. In a travel-rescue sequence, the survivor may be the one who keeps the newly recovered bearing on land.

activation_trace.role: The sea-to-dry-land transition gives qasd a literal terrain on which a course can continue.
Directed movement toward a goal makes muqtasid a survivor who retains orientation.
Straightness of path and gait turns retained orientation into continued conduct.

changed_reading.before: Muqtasid means only moderately observant or middling.
changed_reading.after: One live reading is navigational: some survivors continue on a directed, straight course after landfall.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The partition f مِنهم leaves a measured subgroup before the totalizing كل ختار كفور.
baseline_models.mechanism: The moderation branch of qasd supports partial, bounded fidelity rather than full crisis intensity; the contrast between a subgroup and the all-encompassing vice formula keeps this reading distinct from directional constancy.

activation_trace.role: A middle position between extremes supports measured, incomplete persistence after rescue.
Total inclusion intensifies the opposed vice formula and leaves the earlier subgroup deliberately non-total.
Failure of fidelity marks the adverse pole without forcing every partial survivor into it.

changed_reading.before: Muqtasid must be either wholly praiseworthy or a euphemism for denial.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting reading preserves measured partial fidelity: crisis-total devotion settles into a bounded middle that is not identical with treacherous denial.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: After rescue, the ayah moves from signs to knowing denial, betrayal, and intensive ingratitude.
baseline_models.mechanism: A manifest sign has just been experienced. Juhūd denies what is inwardly known, khatr breaks the crisis fidelity, and kufr re-covers both truth and favor. Once the wave's cover is removed, the denier becomes the covering agent.

activation_trace.role: A visible mark makes the rescue available as evidence rather than private sentiment.
Denial against inward knowledge makes the reversal deliberate rather than uninformed.
Treachery and failure to fulfill convert crisis allegiance into a broken fidelity.
Covering returns as the human action that hides what the removed wave exposed.
Covering a favor makes rescue itself the blessing suppressed by post-crisis conduct.

changed_reading.before: The ending generically condemns unbelievers and the ungrateful.
changed_reading.after: The ending diagnoses a post-rescue counteraction: known evidence and received favor are deliberately re-covered, betraying the allegiance voiced under threat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered context builds a route lexicon: gentle guidance, loss of guidance and qasd, an extended path, and finally the command to enact qasd in walking. This turns the focus participle into embodied retention of bearing while leaving moderation live.

activation_trace.role: The focus word supplies the straight-course anchor that the context route network activates.
Gentle direction toward the right path supplies the positive bearing.
Straying explicitly away from guidance and qasd supplies the negative counterpart.
An extended traversable path turns the contrast into a route mechanism.
Straight, even walking makes qasd an enacted gait before it names the rescued subgroup.
Literal movement supplies the bodily carrier of the straight course.

structural_cues: The sequence 31:3, 31:6, and 31:19 moves from guidance to path-loss to regulated gait before the sea scene.
The sea-to-land transition in 31:32 makes continued bearing pragmatically salient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guidance, straying from qasd, path, and qasd-in-walking; I infer that the later participle retains this travel mechanism after landfall; the materially live alternative is economic or ethical moderation without a route image.

changed_reading.before: Muqtasid is a static label for a moderate person.
changed_reading.after: Muqtasid can be the survivor whose crisis-recovered orientation becomes a straight, embodied gait on land; measured moderation remains a separate reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sign encounter depicts turning away and treating the ear as heavy despite recitation. Joined to the focus sequence of covering, visible sign, and knowing denial, kufr becomes manufactured perceptual insulation.

activation_trace.role: Literal storm-covering supplies the physical state later imitated by self-covering.
Knowing denial identifies the insulation as willed rather than mere lack of access.
Covering supplies the human reenactment of the enclosure that the rescue removed.
The recited sign is an outwardly available marker against which closure occurs.
Turning away gives denial a bodily direction.
Hearing as understanding and compliance shows what the feigned deafness blocks.
Ear-heaviness supplies the image of deliberately thickened access to a sign.

structural_cues: Both 31:7 and 31:32 use an إذا encounter with signs followed by a response.
The focus reverses physical covering into moral covering only after the sign-bearing rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily turning, blocked understanding, storm-covering, and knowing denial; I infer a repeated enclosure mechanism moving from environment to perception; the alternative is that 31:7 is only a separate portrait of arrogance.

changed_reading.before: Post-rescue denial is a bare change of opinion.
changed_reading.after: Denial is enacted self-insulation: the rescued person rebuilds, through turning and blocked uptake, the cover from which the body was freed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context's outward/inward blessing pair activates a four-step reversal in the focus: outward cover, inward purification, outward rescue-sign, inward re-covering. Surface and interior exchange which one reveals and which one hides.

activation_trace.role: Outward emergence and disclosure supply the surface pole of the reversal.
Hidden inward reality supplies the interior pole where sincerity and later suppression operate.
External covering begins the focus sequence by hiding and enclosing bodies.
Inner purification answers the external enclosure with clarified allegiance.
The rescue becomes an outwardly legible mark.
Renewed covering closes the sequence inside the perceiver.

structural_cues: 31:20 explicitly coordinates outward and inward blessings.
31:32 alternates an external state, an internal posture, an external event, and an internal counter-posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the outward/inward pair and the focus alternation; I infer a chiastic transfer of covering between world and perceiver; the alternative is a simple chronological sequence with no designed surface-interior symmetry.

changed_reading.before: The ayah moves linearly from danger to prayer to rescue to denial.
changed_reading.after: An exploratory chiasm emerges: outward concealment reveals the inward state, outward deliverance becomes a sign, and the inward state then conceals that sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the context, calling is a directional force: the adversary calls people, false objects are called upon, and under the wave people call God exclusively. Crisis temporarily collapses a field of competing summons into one true orientation.

activation_trace.role: The focus call inclines speech and attention toward God under threat.
Exclusive separation from partnership makes the call a singular allegiance.
A rival caller inclines the same people toward a destructive destination.
The rebellious caller personifies the competing summons.
Calling upon what is besides God supplies the rival address that crisis excludes.
Loss of truth and stability marks the rival call's footing as unable to hold.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the true pole toward which the storm-call turns.

structural_cues: The subject-object reversal is sharp: in 31:21 they are called, in 31:30 other objects are called, and in 31:32 they call God.
Exclusive dīn grammatically narrows the addressee at the crisis peak.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three call configurations and the true/false contrast; I infer that crisis reorients agency within a competing-call field; the alternative is that the repeated root is thematic but not mechanistically linked to relapse.

changed_reading.before: The sea prayer is an isolated spontaneous plea.
changed_reading.after: The plea is a temporary realignment of caller, addressee, and destination within a wider contest of summons; landfall tests whether that alignment persists.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ship verse names divine favor and signs for every steadfast, grateful person. The focus then stages the assay in time: enclosure tests self-restraint, rescue tests recognition of favor, and khattār-kafūr names failure after the second phase.

activation_trace.role: The literal ship places the sign-recognition pair aboard the same maritime scene as the focus.
Divine favor supplies what rescue later requires the survivor to recognize.
Manifest markers frame the voyage and its reversal as evidence to be read.
Holding the self from panic supplies the virtue appropriate to the wave phase.
A hardship with no apparent exit sharpens steadfastness into the exact enclosure tested by the wave.
Recognition of favor supplies the virtue appropriate to landfall.
Turbulent wave movement instantiates the first, steadfastness-testing phase.
Covering the favor names the inverse outcome of the gratitude phase.

structural_cues: 31:31 and 31:32 are adjacent and share ship, sea, signs, and the كل character formula.
The focus's temporal clauses divide the episode into danger and after-rescue response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent maritime sign frame and the steadfast-grateful pair; I infer that 31:32 narratively tests the pair in successive phases; the alternative is that the pair only describes observers and does not structure the episode.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is simply an example of inconsistent emergency piety.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is a two-phase sign assay: steadfastness belongs under enclosure, while gratitude becomes decisive after rescue, where betrayal can re-cover the favor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nearby return, brief enjoyment, compulsion, and appointed term reopen the future after rescue. Barr is safe relative to the wave but remains inside a timed moral itinerary, so rescue is reprieve and testing ground rather than terminal arrival.

activation_trace.role: Raised flood-safe ground supplies genuine local rescue without implying finality.
Dry land marks a relative destination opposed to sea.
Return to a prior destination reopens movement beyond apparent landfall.
Extended enjoyment supplies the provisional interval after immediate danger.
Smallness contracts that interval and prevents it from reading as final safety.
Compulsion removes the survivor's control over the next transition.
A fixed temporal limit places all movement, including rescued movement, under an endpoint.

structural_cues: The ethical division occurs after rescue, showing that land begins rather than ends the decisive response.
31:23-24 and 31:29 repeatedly place present continuance inside return and term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies local rescue, return, short enjoyment, compulsion, and term; I infer that landfall is a probationary interval; the alternative is that the later timing language concerns only final judgment and should not color the rescue scene.

changed_reading.before: Reaching land is the completed happy endpoint of the episode.
changed_reading.after: Landfall is real but provisional safety: it opens the interval in which remembered orientation, gratitude, or betrayal becomes visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate warning against worldly deception activates a reversal: the wave is overtly dangerous but disclosure-producing, whereas restored terrestrial ease can gleam without stability and induce re-covering. Shore can therefore be ethically more dangerous than sea.

activation_trace.role: Dry land supplies the returned ordinary environment whose safety can be overread.
Broken fidelity names the behavioral result of trusting the returned calm.
Covering the rescue-favor is the cognitive effect attributed to deceptive ease.
A gleam that does not hold supplies the mechanism by which apparent safety displaces crisis clarity.
Unknown risk in the outcome makes confidence in the calm shore structurally hazardous.
The near present life locates the deceptive horizon in returned ordinary existence.

structural_cues: The deception warning immediately follows the focus ayah.
The focus places betrayal only after the transition to land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies post-land betrayal and an immediate warning about unstable worldly deception; I infer that returned ease is one vehicle of that deception; the alternative is a general warning unrelated to the shore transition.

changed_reading.before: Sea is danger and shore is unqualified safety.
changed_reading.after: Sea is bodily danger that exposes allegiance, while shore may become ethical danger by making the exposed truth seem unnecessary once calm returns.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the breaking branch is form-distant from the participial use of muqtasid; it remains anchored in the exact focus root, the rescue-by-separation sequence, and the subgroup syntax. Downstream prose should present it only as an imagistic echo of a severed remainder, never as a lexical replacement for moderation or straightness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: From among the rescued group, a muqtasid remains after separation from the engulfing whole.

activation_trace.role: Breaking and separation activate a branch-distant image of a remainder cut out from the former mass.
Rescue by separation gives the broken-off image a real event-level anchor.
Total inclusion in the vice formula supplies the whole against which the rescued subgroup appears as a remainder.

changed_reading.before: Muqtasid only classifies a survivor's degree or direction of fidelity.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch echo, muqtasid can also image a survivor severed from the engulfing totality and left as a morally undecided remainder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant l-j-j target attached to the context root w-l-j. It remains valid as activation because that target explicitly supplies sea-depth and darkness while the focus supplies literal wave, canopy, and raised rescue ground. Downstream prose must call it a split-root cross-domain overlay, not claim that w-l-j or the focus words lexically mean sea-depth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The wave-canopy encloses people before rescue lifts them onto flood-safe ground.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped target contributes the depth and enclosure of the sea to the repeated insertion movement.
Interwoven darkness turns night insertion into a covering motion parallel to the storm canopy.
Literal turbulent wave motion anchors the overlay in the focus scene.
Night-darkness within the shade root links canopy enclosure to the neighboring night/day cycle.
Raised ground beyond flood supplies the emergence pole opposite dark maritime ingress.

changed_reading.before: The storm is a self-contained natural danger between two stable states.
changed_reading.after: In a contained split-root overlay, storm and rescue become ingress and emergence across a dark maritime threshold, resonating with the neighboring insertion of night and day.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the later rain cue activates both gh-y-th relief and its non-dominant gh-w-th distress-cry target. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit wave, call, and rescue, all within a water field. Downstream prose should frame this as a hydrological reversal analogy, not equate rain lexically with the sea wave or assert that the call mechanically causes weather.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Water engulfs, people call, and God rescues; the closing context presents descending water through a relief/cry split inventory.

activation_trace.role: Relief of one in distress makes descending water an aid-side counterpart to the threatening wave.
The non-dominant distress-aid target activates succor at the exact pressure point staged in the focus.
A cry for help mirrors the focus's spoken call from within danger.
The turbulent wave fixes water's threatening pole in the focus.
The directed call supplies the human pivot between threat and hoped-for aid.
Rescue by separation supplies the realized relief pole.

changed_reading.before: Water is only the hostile medium from which the people must be removed.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory water-cycle analogy, the same domain can bear engulfment or descending relief; the call occupies the reversal point between water as threat and water as succor.

strongest_changes: Muqtasid shifts from a single middling label into coexisting directional and measured readings, with a contained severed-remainder echo.
The adjacent ship-sign verse turns the focus into a two-phase assay: steadfastness under enclosure and gratitude after rescue.
Rescue is doubled as inward unentangling and outward extraction, while denial deliberately rebuilds covering after the wave-cover is removed.
Landfall becomes a provisional and potentially deceptive testing interval rather than an unqualified endpoint.
summary.what_was_special: The focus repeatedly reverses one image: covering first belongs to the wave, purification uncovers allegiance, rescue exposes a sign, and the khattār-kafūr then becomes the agent who covers known favor. Ordered route cues, the preceding ṣabbār-shakūr pair, and non-dominant mapped roots preserve several mechanistic readings without collapsing them.
remaining_uncertainties: The balance between directional straightness and measured partial fidelity in muqtasid remains intentionally unresolved.
The visible-hidden chiasm and deceptive-shore reading are sequence-based inferences rather than necessary lexical entailments.
The l-j-j and gh-w-th outliers depend on non-dominant mapped inventories and must remain qualified activations, not glosses.
